title: nearestNeighbor
summary: Find nearest DelaunayTri vertices for query points.

gpu_support.notes: `nearestNeighbor` reads DelaunayTri object topology and performs host geometric search.

description: `nearestNeighbor(dt, q)` returns one-based indices of the nearest triangulation vertices for an N-by-2 query matrix. `nearestNeighbor(dt, x, y)` accepts coordinate vectors.
behaviors: Accepts query matrices or paired coordinate vectors.
Returns an N-by-1 tensor of one-based vertex indices.
Returns NaN for queries against an empty point set.
